goal: Help node operators identify resource-intensive or abusive peers
Track and expose message processing CPU usage per peer in getpeerinfo and -netinfo
Lay groundwork for future peer-prioritization and anti-DoS measures
reviewability: Author silent for 180 days; review may wait a long time for a response
agreement: Wide concept support for peer CPU tracking to combat DoS (jonatack, laanwj, mzumsande, hodlinator)
Verified in testing on signet IBD and -netinfo (jonatack, BrandonOdiwuor, yuvicc)
Unaddressed objection: metrics are non-actionable, flame graphs or wall time are better (ajtowns)
Nonblocking objection: exploratory metrics should not go into production getpeerinfo (sipa)
Suggested using a decaying average instead of connection-wide average (sipa)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because exploratory peer monitoring metrics without external demand offer modest value
Provides diagnostic value during DoS investigation but remains marginal

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because cross-platform thread CPU timing utilities are incremental internal infrastructure
Utility benefit is limited to supporting exploratory diagnostics
